name: duplicacy-exporter
description: Prometheus exporter for Duplicacy backup metrics. Provides real-time progress, speed, and post-run summaries for Grafana dashboards. Supports Duplicacy CLI (via Docker log tailing or file monitoring) and Duplicacy Web UI (via webhook). Tiny Alpine image (~30 MB). Three collection modes: log_tail (Docker socket), log_file (file path), or webhook (HTTP push). More info: https://github.com/GeiserX/duplicacy-exporter
